transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I came in because... well, I just keep thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up anymore. Honestly, sometimes I feel like dying would be the fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and to my crew at work.
Have you ever felt this way or experienced a similar period of deep depression in the past, or is this the first time you've felt like this?

I'm not really sure. It's... it's hard to remember what things used to be like, honestly. I don't know if I've had a specific time exactly like this before. I just know that right now, it's really bad. I haven't really kept track of the past, I guess. I just can't seem to get past how heavy everything feels right now.
Are you currently hearing voices, seeing things that aren't there, or feeling like people or outside forces are controlling your thoughts or actions?

Yes, I am. I hear a man's voice. It usually comes from right behind me when I'm at a job site working on a floor, or sometimes when I'm just in my kitchen. He says things like... you missed it, or he'll say everyone knows. It sounds so clear, exactly as if someone is standing right there behind me. But when I turn around to look, nobody is ever there. I haven't been seeing things or feeling controlled, though, it is just that voice.
Does this voice speak to you even when you are feeling relatively stable and not experiencing these deep, depressed moods?

Yes, actually. Um, there was a stretch of... I think it was several weeks, not too long ago. I was feeling a bit better, you know? Like, I was getting up in the morning, eating a little better, and I wasn't crying all day like I have been lately. But... I still heard the voice. Especially at work. And even though my mood was better, I was still completely convinced that my clients and the suppliers were tracking me. So, yeah, it doesn't just happen when I'm feeling really down.
Looking back at the times when you were not feeling depressed, how long would you say the voice or the belief that people were tracking you persisted without any mood symptoms present?

Like I was just saying a second ago, it was a stretch of several weeks. Um, for that whole time, I was actually getting up, eating a little better, and not crying all day. But even without the heavy mood, I still heard the voice while I was at work, and I stayed completely convinced that the clients and suppliers were tracking me. So, it lasted for those several weeks, at least.
Looking back over the last year or so, have you been hearing that voice or feeling like you were being tracked for a total of six months or longer?

Yeah, it has been longer than six months. Um... looking back, I'd say the voice and the whole thing with being tracked through my jobs and messages, that has been happening for around eleven months now.
Over the past eleven months that you've been dealing with these voices and thoughts, would you say that you have spent more time feeling this deep depression than you have feeling relatively stable?

Yes, definitely. I mean... for most of the time since all this started eleven months ago, the depression has just been there. Um, the guilt, feeling completely exhausted, not caring about things I used to like, and... and having those thoughts about death. They've been pretty constant. There were some weeks that were maybe a little less crushing, like I mentioned before, but overall... yeah, the depression has taken up most of that time.
